name: Vietnam EVN Grid Code Compliance — Circular 39/2015/TT-BCT & Circular 30/2019/TT-BCT
standard: Circular 39/2015/TT-BCT (Distribution Power System Regulation) + Circular 30/2019/TT-BCT (Amending Distribution Grid Code) + Circular 25/2016/TT-BCT (Transmission Grid Code) + EVN Technical Connection Guidelines
description: Grid code compliance and technical connection verification for solar power plants and distributed solar connecting to EVN distribution networks (22kV / 35kV) and transmission grids (110kV / 220kV). Validates power quality metrics: steady-state frequency operating range (49.5 Hz – 50.5 Hz normal, 47.5 Hz – 52.0 Hz emergency ride-through); voltage variation limits (±5% at point of common coupling); total harmonic distortion (THD ≤ 5% for voltage, individual harmonics compliant with IEC 61000-3-6); power factor control range (cos phi ≥ 0.90 leading/lagging at POI); anti-islanding protection per IEEE 1547 with trip time < 2.0 seconds; relay protection settings (overcurrent 50/51, under/over-voltage 27/59, under/over-frequency 81U/81O, auto-reclose 79); SCADA/RTU integration using IEC 60870-5-104 protocol for remote dispatch by EVN Regional Load Dispatch Centers (A1/A2/A3/A0); Zero-Export controller with class 0.5S smart energy meter.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
